description: AI answer visibility check: sends a real query to a live AI model with web search enabled and checks the response for a mention of the business and a citation linking to its domain. Returns mentioned, cited, citations and an excerpt. Costs $0.031 per call via x402.

business.description: Business name to check for a mention.

domain.description: Optional. Domain to check for a citation, in addition to a name mention.

query.description: The question to ask the AI model. Max 500 characters.
